programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Tai Jin mengahwini Xi Wu dan menganugerahkannya gelaran permaisuri. Pada malam perkahwinan mereka, Xi Wu menyerang Tai Jin secara tiba-tiba. Namun, serangan itu memakan diri, menyebabkan mereka sama-sama cedera teruk.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Shanhe memberitahu Baozhen dan Renmei bahawa mereka telah diserang. Hospital memaklumkan Renmei bahawa San Hao berada dalam keadaan kritikal dan memerlukan pembedahan pemindahan hati dengan segera.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kimura mengulas keputusan Renmei untuk mengahwini San Hao yang dalam keadaan kritikal dan sebaliknya menerima makian daripada Xiulian. Hero memandu untuk melanggar Wenling tapi diselamatkan oleh Presiden Fang dan Qianna/ Xiao Ai.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Yuan Ge yang mengalami penyakit rahim, kini dalam pemantauan dan rawatan doktor. Sebelum ini, doktor memberi amaran bahawa penyakit tersebut boleh mengakibatkan kemandulan jika tidak diberikan rawatan yang sewajarnya.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Dua beradik Wang Mu Sheng dan Wang Jin Sheng yang berasal sebagai pengemis, tiba di Huludun untuk mencari rezeki. Mereka membuka gerai untuk menjual kuih tradisional setelah mendapat petunjuk daripada Dewa Guan Sheng Di.

programme.title: MY ONE AND ONLY
programme.desc: Limin berasa tertipu dengan tanah yang dibelinya tetapi tidak mahu mengalah. Andy membuat persembahan untuk menghiburnya dan berjanji untuk membantunya. Zhongyi memutuskan untuk melawat Mei di penjara. Dia tidak boleh memaafkannya.

programme.title: THIS IS MY SHOW
programme.desc: Peserta-peserta dengan bakat berbeza akan dilatih oleh penerbit dan jemputan selebriti terkenal daripada pelbagai bidang antaranya lakonan, nyanyian, peragaan bagi melahirkan bakat muda yang versatil.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Gundik Yue menggalakkan agar Bu Yi dan Shao Shang berkahwin cepat supaya keturunan keluarga Ling diteruskan. Puteri Luo Yang merasakan ada sesuatu tak kena, lantas Maharaja Wen menegaskan perkahwinan Bu Yi adalah keputusannya.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Keghairahan Wang Long untuk kejayaan yang pantas dengan cara menekan penyamun membawa kepada kekalahan tentera. Sepupu Wang Long, iaitu seorang putera raja mahu mewakili Wang Long untuk meminta maaf daripada Maharaja.

programme.title: OPM
programme.desc: OPM Alliance mensasarkan London Gold Group, yang telah menipu Simon Sir kehilangan semua simpanannya. Hook cuba memikat anak perempuan pemilik London Gold Group, manakala Harry dan Kathy pula menyamar.

programme.title: THE TREASURED VOICE S7
programme.desc: Episod ini menyaksikan 14 penyanyi popular China dan Taiwan berganding dalam 7 pasangan di pentas "The Treasured Voice". Persembahan memukau Rainie Yang dan Lars Huang akhirnya dinobatkan sebagai lagu terbaik pilihan juri.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Uncle Heng yang terdengar khabar angin bahawa Jia Cai menganiaya Kian Heng dalam kes gangguan seksual cuba untuk membalas dendam. Yun Han tampil untuk membuktikan Jia Cai tidak bersalah.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Jin Kok meninggalkan rumah tanpa memaklumkan kepada sesiapa. Dia tersesat ketika menuju ke sebuah pusat jagaan orang tua. Walau bagaimanapun, Yi Shi berjaya menemuinya. Sementara itu, Ren Hui telah keluar dari hospital.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kimura Kenji secara rahsia membayar syarikat gaun pengantin untuk menghantar gaun pengantin dan sekeping surat kononnya daripada Zhihong bagi memberkati perkahwinan antara San Hao dan Renmei. Semua orang teruja dengan susunan itu.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Selepas mengetahui Baozhen adalah ibu kandung kepada San Hao, pihak hospital dengan segera mengatur pembedahan pemindahan hati. Jin Chuan adalah orang yang membawa Min Foong ke hospital untuk bertemu dengan Shanhe dan Baozhen.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Gu Qiao terperangkap di dalam pejabat dan terpaksa merangkak keluar dari pintu belakang Pusat Spa kerana terkunci dari dalam oleh pegawai atasannya. Yuan Ge memberikan kata-kata motivasi untuk membangkitkan semangatnya.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Shui Qing yang ketagih berjudi, menanggung hutang besar. Dia bersekongkol dengan penjenayah, berpura-pura dirinya diculik untuk menuntut wang tebusan. Mu Sheng yang baik hati, ditikam mati ketika menghantar wang tebusan.

programme.title: CANTON FLAVOR SEASON 8
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan masakan Kantonis istimewa yang disyorkan oleh beberapa orang tukang masak yang berpengalaman. Antaranya termasuk merpati goreng, ikan kukus ala Kantonis, abalon rebus dan cendawan goreng dari Yunnan.

programme.title: TOGETHER, HERE WE ARE
programme.desc: Ikuti pengembaraan hos untuk mengenali keunikan budaya dan berbilang bangsa di Malaysia.

programme.title: STEP FORWARD ( SS11 )
programme.desc: Episod ini Baki Zainal mengunjungi Pasir Mas, Kelantan. Dia bertemu bual dengan seorang Tok Dalang, Eyo Hock Seng yang berumur 61 tahun mengenai wayang kulit yang diminati olehnya sejak dia berumur 10 tahun.

programme.title: TOP SINGERS
programme.desc: Episod ini menyaksikan kelahiran Juara Cilik Nyanyian ke-8. Para juara Pertandingan Juara Cilik Nyanyian dari edisi pertama hingga ketujuh, turut dijemput untuk membuat penampilan khas dan memberi persembahan di pentas.

programme.title: HO CHAK! 2025/2026
programme.desc: Episod ini hos Orange menemubual Tan Chia Yong sambil mengunjungi tiga kedai makan di Kuala Selangor iaitu di Batu Arang, Bestari Jaya dan Pasir Penampang. Mereka memperkenalkan serta menikmati pelbagai hidangan menarik disyorkan tetamu.

programme.title: OPM
programme.desc: Master Gu melarikan wang kepunyaan Tao Ye dan ditangkap balik oleh orang suruhan Tao Ye. Tao Ye mengugut Harry dan rakan-rakannya supaya menaikkan harga satu saham blue-chip tertentu ke paras tinggi sebelum hujung bulan.

programme.title: SUPER DIVA SEASON 9
programme.desc: Episod ini 4 wanita membuat persembahan pentas di samping berkongsi cerita pengalaman dalam perniagaan, pertemuan semula adik beradik yang terpisah, pengorbanan merealisasikan impian anak dan mempelajari balet pada usia 42 tahun.

programme.title: JOY OF LIFE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Fan Xian menyelinap masuk ke Istana Timur untuk menghadap Raja Qing dengan bantuan Menteri Chen. Fan Xian memberitahu bahawa Putera Kedua dan Puteri Sulong bersekongkol dengan Qi Utara dalam perdagangan penyeludupan.

programme.title: JOY OF LIFE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Fan Xian menyiasat sebuah tempat hiburan yang mencurigakan. Fan Xian mendapatkan maklumat Bao Yue Lou dari seorang pelacur dengan bantuan Wang Qi Nian. Fan Xian memasuki Bao Jue Lou dengan mengikuti konvoi peniaga.

programme.desc: A rural town gets excited when the local panchayat leader decides to make electricity available in the village. However, issues erupt when these benefits give rise to a series of dire situations.

programme.title: Panchajanyam
programme.desc: Venu, a lorry driver, tries to save the family of his late father's boss from an evil businessman. However, he ends up in a fix when he learns that the evil businessman is none other than his boss.

programme.title: Paapam Cheyyathavar Kalleriyatte

programme.title: Europe Malayalee Journal

programme.title: Bandhukkal Sathrukkal
programme.desc: Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.

programme.title: Aniyan Bava Chetan Bava
programme.desc: An intense rivalry ensues between two brothers after their daughters fall in love with their driver. However, things take a drastic turn after their rivalry becomes a matter of their family prestige.

programme.title: Prajapathi
programme.desc: Narayanan, who gets convicted for killing his father, returns from prison to his village and works selflessly for its people. However, his vengeful relatives create obstacles for him.

programme.title: Bharya Athra Pora

programme.title: Vallikkudilile Vellakkaran

programme.title: Bhoothakkannadi
programme.desc: Vidyadharan, a clockmaker and widower, lives only for his daughter. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he kills a thug, whom he suspected of murdering a village girl.

programme.title: By the People
programme.desc: Rajan, a policeman, goes after a powerful criminal but ends up losing his wife and is also left crippled. Soon, he becomes a jailer and recruits four vigilantes to trap the kingpin who ruined his life.

programme.title: Mohabbath

programme.title: Paribhavam Parvathi

programme.title: Njan Salperu Ramankutty
programme.desc: Ramankutty, a respected school-teacher, agrees to marry one of his uncle's daughters. However, he changes his mind after meeting another cousin, making his life difficult in society.

programme.title: Samrajyam
programme.desc: Alexander is a powerful underworld don. However, he strives to balance his profession and his troubled relationship with his mother.

programme.title: Innale Vare
programme.desc: The life of a struggling actor changes when two individuals take advantage of him and try to dupe him. However, he strives to overcome his obstacles.

programme.title: Achayans

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder. Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden's journey as we explore his life in rural China.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder. Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden's journey as we explore his life in rural China.

programme.title: Ad Break
programme.desc: Ad Break

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. As an outstanding representative of China's late grotto carving art, they integrate the essence of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism in their content, fully embodying the beauty of cultural integration. This episode comprehensively showcases the profound historical and cultural heritage of Dazu and its vibrant contemporary folk customs, exploring the thematic connotations, artistic characteristics and historical origins of the Dazu Stone Carvings, as well as their far-reaching influence on the local people for generations.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - MACGUFFIN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band MACGUFFIN! This band is composed of drummer SNOOQ vocalist and guitarist Byeon Ha-geum bassist UHI and guitarist Bae Joon-il. The band is named after a technique of the same name that advances a film's plot builds the narrative and helps push the story forward widely popularized by Alfred Hitchcock. Back in 2017 the quartet participated in the Arirang Competition and won the Grand Prize with their unique interpretation of Arirang. Then in 2018 they won the Golden Prize at the Penta Super Rookie and engraved their name in the minds of the public. The members recently completed their mandatory military duties and are so ready to impress listeners with their matured musicality. In this episode MACGUFFIN performs Sinpa Bucket List Highway and more to showcase their artistic prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Car, the garden
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Car the Garden! This artist made his big debut in the music industry in 2013 under the name Mason the Soul. Then in 2017 he changed his stage name to Car the Garden a literal translation of his name Cha Jeong-won and pleasantly surprised everyone in indie circles with his unique voice and dream-like sounds. The following year he became the final winner of the fan-voting audition program The Fan and further secured his position in the industry. Last month Car the Garden released his much-anticipated new album Absence. Featuring 5 tracks the album is filled with his distinct warm sounds and also showcases his growth as a musician. In this episode Car the Garden performs Tree Sarah and Home Sweet Home as well asMy Whole World and Doesn't Matter from his latest album. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Yang Da Il
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer with a heartrending voice... Yang Da Il! This artist garnered much attention even before his official debut by taking part in Jung Key's songs Be Forgotten and This Intense Moment in 2011 as a guest vocalist. 4 years later in 2015 Yang Da Il made his official debut with the single Think and engraved his name in the minds of the public with his iconic heartrending voice. In January this year Yang Da Il released his second full-length album our joys and sadnesses to depict love and breakups. His new songs dominated the top spots of music charts and proved once again how beloved he is as a musician. In this episode Yang Da Il performs Loss Darling Sometimes Hurt and Sorry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy his depiction of love and separation!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Babylon
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is R&B musician Babylon! This artist made his big debut in 2015 with the single PRAY and immediately captured listeners' hearts with his unusual soulful vibes. Then he engraved his names in the minds of the public by featuring in ZICO's Boys And Girls which led him to collaborate with a number of top artists in the industry including Verbal Zint The Quiett Nucksal BewhY Suzy Chungha Yubin and more. This February Babylon returned to the industry with his much-anticipated new album Hardy packed to the brim with collaborations and songs. One of the lead singles Alone was written composed and produced by Lee Hyo-ri and another lead single Like Song features top rapper Jay Park. Babylon also worked with Kid Milli Coogie KYLE LO Samuel Seo Lee Young-ji Queen WA$ABII and more for the album. In this episode Babylon performs Like Song Dawn Fog Chandelier Red Lipstick and White Suit to showcase the essence of his musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - GSoul
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the soulful singer-songwriter GSoul! GSoul is a big name in the music industry. Known for his exceptional soulful voice and songwriting skills he garnered much attention even before his official debut. To further engrave his name in the minds of the public he took part in the competition show “Voice Korea 2020” last year and won first place impressing everyone with his outstanding musicality once again. This past February this artist released the duet Can Love Be Fair? with Ben to depict a couple experiencing unequal love. GSoul's soulful vocals definitely make this song more heartrending. In this episode GSoul performs Hate Everything Bad Habits Let Me Know Another Sad Love Song Broken Record as well as his solo version of Can Love Be Fair? Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and let this artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kwon Jin-ah
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kwon Jin-ah! This artist became known to the public in 2013 after taking part in K-Pop Star Season 3. 3 years later in 2016 she made her official debut with the album One Strange Night and topped all the music charts with the lead single The End. Particularly known for her delicate ability to express emotions she has collaborated with various top-notch musicians and also taken part in many soundtracks. This past February Kwon Jin-ah released her first collaborative single with Gaeko I Feel Like and dominated the top spots of music charts again. February was definitely a busy month for this artist - she also released her EP The Way For Us. Due to her active participation in the creative process both as a songwriter and producer the album beautifully displays her distinct musicality. She likens each of her songs in the EP to a short story making her new album a collection of 6 short stories. In this episode Kwon Jin-ah performs Something's Wrong Flower Heart You already have Good Bye I got lucky and The way for Us. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy her beautiful songs!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - MOVNING
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents the Music & Lyrics Special in celebration of its 4th anniversary! And the first guest of the special trilogy is MOVNING. MOVNING is composed of three elementary school friends Kang Ha-rim Lim Jun-hyuk and Hwang In-gyu. Built on piano bass and drums they sing about the frustration and defiance of young adults as well as the love and hope they experience. Also the band's leader Kang Ha-rim is actively involved in the creative process as a composer lyricist and even a producer impressing listeners with his outstanding musicality. In this episode MOVNING performs Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry Twilight Of Youth Falling With You Magellan Polar Night and Dead Sea. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the shining youth they portray!

programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the soulful singer-songwriter GSoul! GSoul is a big name in the music industry. Known for his exceptional soulful voice and songwriting skills he garnered much attention even before his official debut. To further engrave his name in the minds of the public he took part in the competition show “Voice Korea 2020” last year and won first place impressing everyone with his outstanding musicality once again. This past February this artist released the duet Can Love Be Fair? with Ben to depict a couple experiencing unequal love. GSoul's soulful vocals definitely make this song more heartrending. In this episode GSoul performs Hate Everything Bad Habits Let Me Know Another Sad Love Song Broken Record as well as his solo version of Can Love Be Fair? Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and let this artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kwon Jin-ah
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kwon Jin-ah! This artist became known to the public in 2013 after taking part in K-Pop Star Season 3. 3 years later in 2016 she made her official debut with the album One Strange Night and topped all the music charts with the lead single The End. Particularly known for her delicate ability to express emotions she has collaborated with various top-notch musicians and also taken part in many soundtracks. This past February Kwon Jin-ah released her first collaborative single with Gaeko I Feel Like and dominated the top spots of music charts again. February was definitely a busy month for this artist - she also released her EP The Way For Us. Due to her active participation in the creative process both as a songwriter and producer the album beautifully displays her distinct musicality. She likens each of her songs in the EP to a short story making her new album a collection of 6 short stories. In this episode Kwon Jin-ah performs Something's Wrong Flower Heart You already have Good Bye I got lucky and The way for Us. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy her beautiful songs!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JEONGMILLA
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents the Music & Lyrics Special in celebration of its 4th anniversary! And the second guest of the special trilogy is singer-songwriter JEONGMILLA. JEONGMILLA is known for her delicate poetic depictions of everyday life combined with heartwarming folk sounds. Interestingly enough she started off her career through fine arts after graduating from the prestigious Korea National University of Arts. And she says music and art are both important to her in different ways. In October last year JEONGMILLA released her third full-length album CheongPa Sonata. Inspired by the neighborhood she lives in Cheongpa-dong she delicately painted the quotidian scenes of the area with her personal stories. Since its release the album has been highly recommended by critics on various music charts and with this album she won three trophies at the 2021 Korean Music Awards -- Best Song - Folk Best Album - Folk and Best Album of the Year. In this episode JEONGMILLA performs Stars Departing from Seoul Station Old Town Journal During Troubled Times and Wandering. Tune in to I'm LIVE and explore her poetic artistic world!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - AKMU
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents the Music & Lyrics Special in celebration of its 4th anniversary! And the last guest of the special trilogy is the super-talented sibling duo AKMU. The two burst into the K-pop scene in 2013 through the competition program K-Pop Star Season 2 and pleasantly surprised the public with their unrefined pure musicality. After being crowned the winners of the season they made their official debut in 2014 with the album PLAY. The elder brother LEE CHANHYUK is known for his exceptional songwriting skills and the younger sister LEE SUHYUN is famous for her crystal clear voice and together they exude a great synergy that makes them one-of-a-kind in the highly competitive K-pop scene. Then in 2015 the duo won the Best Pop Album at the prestigious Korean Music Awards and once again proved that they enjoy both critical acclaim and commercial appeal. They are on the 7th year of their debut and still touch listeners with their creative interpretations of everyday life stories. In this episode AKMU performs ALIEN DINOSAUR How Can I Love The Heartbreak You're The One I Love LAST GOODBYE and GIVE LOVE to showcase the lyrical beauty of their music. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented siblings!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - SORAN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band SORAN! SORAN is one of Korea's top-notch bands composed of vocalist Ko Young-bae bassist Seo Myeon-ho guitarist Lee Tae-wook and drummer Pyeon Yu-il. Unlike what their band name means disturbance in English they offer lively poppy tunes that are relaxing and pleasing to the ears and have gained a steady following in the indie scene since their debut in 2009. Also known for their warm-hearted lyrics and their flawless performances the quartet never fails to get listeners in a good mood. Recently the four dropped their new mini-album Beloved and also held a free online concert titled Perfect Day 0 : Light Steps via YouTube providing a moment of refreshment to everyone around the world. In this episode SORAN performs Be with me the lead single from their new release Don't Lose Weight Ricotta Cheese Salad Confession Of Love and Our Journey. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four outstanding musicians!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: The funniest cat videos on the internet are celebrated in this hilarious compilation show. From humble moggies terrorised by the toaster or getting stuck in a hamster ball -V to Grumpy Cat, whose trademark scowl has earned her more cash than a Hollywood A-lister.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Lucy the Staffie cross has been kept inside a dark house for so long that it's affected her eyes and she is extremely overweight. She is taken into the RSPCA's care but will Lucy be able to shed some pounds and adapt to life in the great outdoors?

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Early morning at the Brash household and Dr. Matt and his wife Clare, a horse vet, with their children enjoy a traditional English breakfast - on a traditional Dales day. They're off to the Malton Show. It's been an annual event for over a century, a chance for local people to meet and compete for prizes with their finest produce. In a rural community, vets are crucial. Matt started as a farm vet before specialising in exotic animals. The show also gives him an opportunity to keep in touch with livestock.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。
